feedback.Physical Object: Included — A discrete, bounded unit such as a cartridge, pitcher, or housing.

feedback.Signalling: Excluded — Basic units provide no structured feedback (unless smart-enabled).
feedback.Rule-governed: Excluded — Behavior is governed by physical process, not logical rules.

feedback.Temporal: Included — Function degrades over time or volume; usage is lifespan-dependent.
feedback.Digital/Virtual: Excluded — Not based on or defined by software or virtual logic.
feedback.Institutionally Defined: Included — Subject to standards such as NSF/ANSI for health and safety.
feedback.Identity-Linked: Excluded — Not associated with identity or social role.
feedback.Regulated: Included — Water filters are regulated to meet contaminant reduction and safety benchmarks.
feedback.Economically Significant: Included — Part of a major industry spanning home, commercial, and humanitarian markets.
feedback.Politicised: Excluded — Not subject to ongoing ideological debate.
feedback.Ritualised: Excluded — Not used in cultural or symbolic ceremonies.
feedback.Ethically Significant: Included — Central to global access to clean water and environmental justice issues.
